MFE First-Half Profit Rises After ProSiebenSat.1 Integration
By Aimee Look and Najat Kantouar
MFE-MediaForEurope posted higher operating profit for the first half of 2026 than a year earlier, accounting for the integration of ProSiebenSat.1.

European broadcasting group MFE booked 64.3 million euros in earnings before interest and taxes in the first half, also known as its operating result. Its pro forma result for the year-prior period showed an operating loss of 22.5 million euros.

MFE said its pro forma figures for the previous year were prepared to assume that ProSiebenSat.1 had been consolidated from Jan. 1, 2025. MFE became the German media company's majority shareholder with a 75.61% stake in September 2025.
Net revenue was 2.96 billion euros in the first half, compared with the pro forma figure of 3.14 billion euros in the year-prior period.
MFE backed its full-year guidance for 2026.
